title: Review (.sddpp/reviews/RV-NNN-*.md frontmatter)
description: A review of what people meet, as a whole: a capability when it is complete, or the project when a person asks (the experience standard). The person chooses how it is done; a fresh agent session answers the rubric and proposes each finding as an entry of technical debt, which the person decides on like any other.

mode.description: How the review is done: guide (the person is told what and how to try), explain (the agent says what it will do, then does it), delegate (the agent inspects by itself).

mode_chosen_by.description: The person who chose the mode. Written by `ppc review`.

outside_by.description: The person who says someone other than the builder tried what was built (level 3 of the experience standard), or that it will not be. Written by `ppc outside`.

outside_skipped.description: The person decided not to do the outside test for this review; recorded, and it holds nothing up.

outside_note.description: Who tried it and how it went, or why it was skipped, in the person's words. Optional.

findings.description: The debt entries this review proposed; each one names this review as its origin.
